import AdminLayout from "../../../../../layouts/AdminLayout.astro";
import {
  ForbiddenError,
  requireOrganizationAccess,
} from "../../../../../domain/authorization/guards";
import { getOrganization } from "../../../../../domain/organizations/organizations";
import {
  getCurrentOpenPeriod,
  listPeriods,
} from "../../../../../domain/periods/periods";
import {
  getDashboardSummary,
  type DashboardSummary,
} from "../../../../../domain/periods/dashboard";
import {
  getSetupStatus,
  type SetupProgress,
} from "../../../../../domain/onboarding/progress";
import { withRequestDb } from "../../../../../lib/db-request";

const organizationId = Astro.params.orgId!;
try {
  requireOrganizationAccess(Astro.locals.auth, organizationId);
} catch (err) {
  if (err instanceof ForbiddenError) return Astro.redirect("/unauthorized");
  throw err;
}

const requestedPeriodId = Astro.url.searchParams.get("periodId");

let organization: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getOrganization>>;
let allPeriods: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof listPeriods>>;
let summary: DashboardSummary | null = null;
let attentionCases: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof listCasesForPeriod>> = [];
let setupComplete = true;
let setupProgress: SetupProgress | null = null;
try {
  ({ organization, allPeriods, summary, setupComplete, setupProgress } =
    await withRequestDb(async (db) => {
      const org = await getOrganization(db, organizationId);
      // The starting-readings month is not a billing month to compare with.
      const periods = (await listPeriods(db, organizationId)).filter(
        (p) => !p.openingReadings
      );
      // Progress is calculated once, and only while setup is open.
      const { complete, progress } = await getSetupStatus(
        db,
        organizationId,
        org
      );

      let periodId: string | undefined = requestedPeriodId || undefined;
      if (!periodId) {
        const openPeriod = await getCurrentOpenPeriod(db, organizationId);
        if (openPeriod) {
          periodId = openPeriod.id;
        } else if (periods.length > 0) {
          periodId = periods[0].id;
        }
      }

      const summary = periodId
        ? await getDashboardSummary(db, organizationId, periodId)
        : null;

      if (periodId)
        attentionCases = await listCasesForPeriod(db, organizationId, periodId);
      return {
        organization: org,
        allPeriods: periods,
        summary,
        setupComplete: complete,
        setupProgress: progress,
      };
    }));
} catch {
  return Astro.redirect(`/admin/o/${organizationId}/periods`);
}

const currentIndex = summary
  ? allPeriods.findIndex((p) => p.id === summary.period.id)
  : -1;
const previousPeriod =
  currentIndex >= 0 && currentIndex < allPeriods.length - 1
    ? allPeriods[currentIndex + 1]
    : null;
const nextPeriod = currentIndex > 0 ? allPeriods[currentIndex - 1] : null;

import PageHeader from "../../../../../components/ui/PageHeader.astro";
import FacadeAccent from "../../../../../components/ui/FacadeAccent.astro";
import KpiCard from "../../../../../components/ui/KpiCard.astro";
import StatusBadge from "../../../../../components/ui/StatusBadge.astro";
import EmptyState from "../../../../../components/ui/EmptyState.astro";
import AdminContextDrawer from "../../../../../components/ui/AdminContextDrawer.astro";
import Icon from "../../../../../components/ui/Icon.astro";
import { listCasesForPeriod } from "../../../../../domain/periods/cases";
import {
  translate,
  uiLocale,
  formatMoney,
  formatNumber,
  formatPeriod,
  entityLabel,
} from "../../../../../lib/ui/i18n";
const locale = uiLocale(Astro.cookies, Astro.url);
const t = (text: string) => translate(locale, text);
const base = "/admin/o/" + organizationId;
const statuses = [
  "MISSING_DATA",
  "READY",
  "DRAFT",
  "PREPARED",
  "OVERDUE",
  "SENT",
  "PAID",
] as const;

const setupSteps = setupProgress
  ? [
      {
        title: t("Organization details"),
        done: setupProgress.steps.organization,
        href: `${base}/setup/organization`,
      },
      {
        title: t("Dwellings"),
        done: setupProgress.steps.dwellings,
        href: `${base}/setup/dwellings`,
      },
      {
        title: t("First billing period"),
        done: setupProgress.steps.period,
        href: `${base}/setup/period`,
      },
      {
        title: t("Charges"),
        done: setupProgress.steps.charges,
        href: `${base}/setup/charges`,
      },
      {
        title: t("Meters and starting readings"),
        done: setupProgress.steps.meters,
        href: `${base}/setup/meters`,
      },
    ]
  : [];
const completedSetupSteps = setupSteps.filter((step) => step.done).length;
const nextSetupStep = setupSteps.find((step) => !step.done);
---

<AdminLayout
  title={t("Dashboard") + " - " + organization.name}
  organizationId={organizationId}
  organizationName={organization.name}
>
  {
    !setupComplete && setupProgress && (
      <section
        class="dashboard-setup panel"
        aria-labelledby="dashboard-setup-title"
      >
        <div class="setup-banner-intro">
          <div class="setup-banner-title">
            <h2 id="dashboard-setup-title">{t("Finish setting up")}</h2>
            <span class="setup-banner-count">
              {completedSetupSteps} / {setupSteps.length}{" "}
              {t("Done").toLocaleLowerCase(locale)}
            </span>
          </div>
          {nextSetupStep && (
            <p class="setup-banner-next">
              {t("Next step")}: <strong>{nextSetupStep.title}</strong>
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
        <ol class="setup-banner-steps" aria-label={t("Setup steps")}>
          {setupSteps.map((step, index) => (
            <li>
              <a
                href={step.href}
                class:list={[
                  "setup-banner-step",
                  { "is-done": step.done, "is-next": step === nextSetupStep },
                ]}
              >
                <span class="setup-banner-symbol" aria-hidden="true">
                  {step.done ? <Icon name="check" size="xs" /> : index + 1}
                </span>
                <span>
                  {step.title}
                  <span class="sr-only">
                    : {t(step.done ? "Done" : "To do")}
                  </span>
                </span>
              </a>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ol>
        <a
          class="setup-banner-continue btn-primary"
          href={nextSetupStep?.href ?? `${base}/setup`}
        >
          {t("Continue setup")}
        </a>
      </section>
    )
  }
  {
    !summary ? (
      <div class="space-y-6">
        <PageHeader
          title={t("Dashboard")}
          eyebrow={organization.name}
          description={t(
            "Monitor billing, payments and work requiring attention."
          )}
          display
        />
        {setupComplete && (
          <EmptyState
            ornament
            title={t("No billing periods yet.")}
            description={t(
              "Create a period to start the monthly billing workflow."
            )}
          >
            <a class="btn-primary" href={base + "/periods"}>
              {t("Create period")}
            </a>
          </EmptyState>
        )}
      </div>
    ) : (
      <div class="space-y-6">
        <AdminContextDrawer
          organizationId={organizationId}
          periodId={summary.period.id}
          periodStatus={summary.period.status}
          periodName={formatPeriod(
            summary.period.year,
            summary.period.month,
            locale
          )}
          workbenchPath={base + "/periods/" + summary.period.id}
          refreshSelectors={[".dashboard-attention", ".dashboard-case-status"]}
        />
        <header class="page-header">
          <div>
            <p class="eyebrow">{organization.name}</p>
            <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
              <h1 class="font-display">
                {formatPeriod(
                  summary.period.year,
                  summary.period.month,
                  locale
                )}
              </h1>
              <StatusBadge status={summary.period.status} />
            </div>
            <FacadeAccent />
          </div>
          <div class="page-actions">
            <a
              class="btn-primary"
              href={base + "/periods/" + summary.period.id}
            >
              {t("Open workbench")}
              <Icon name="arrow-right" size="sm" />
            </a>
          </div>
        </header>
        <nav
          class="dashboard-period-nav text-body-sm text-muted"
          aria-label={t("Period navigation")}
        >
          {previousPeriod ? (
            <a
              href={base + "/dashboard?periodId=" + previousPeriod.id}
              class="flex items-center gap-1 hover:text-foreground hover:underline"
            >
              <Icon name="arrow-left" size="xs" />
              {formatPeriod(previousPeriod.year, previousPeriod.month, locale)}
            </a>
          ) : (
            <span class="flex items-center gap-1" aria-disabled="true">
              <Icon name="arrow-left" size="xs" />
              {t("Previous period")}
            </span>
          )}
          {nextPeriod ? (
            <a
              href={base + "/dashboard?periodId=" + nextPeriod.id}
              class="flex items-center gap-1 hover:text-foreground hover:underline"
            >
              {formatPeriod(nextPeriod.year, nextPeriod.month, locale)}
              <Icon name="arrow-right" size="xs" />
            </a>
          ) : (
            <span class="flex items-center gap-1" aria-disabled="true">
              {t("Next period")}
              <Icon name="arrow-right" size="xs" />
            </span>
          )}
        </nav>
        <div class="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
          <>
            <KpiCard
              icon="invoice"
              label={t("Total invoiced")}
              value={formatMoney(
                summary.totalInvoiced,
                organization.currency,
                locale
              )}
            />
            <KpiCard
              icon="coins"
              label={t("Paid")}
              tone="success"
              value={formatMoney(
                summary.totalPaid,
                organization.currency,
                locale
              )}
            />
            <KpiCard
              icon="clock"
              label={t("Outstanding")}
              tone="warning"
              value={formatMoney(
                summary.totalOutstanding,
                organization.currency,
                locale
              )}
            />
          </>
        </div>
        <div class="grid items-start gap-6 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,2fr)_minmax(0,1fr)]">
          <section class="dashboard-attention">
            <div class="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between">
              <>
                <h2 class="font-semibold">{t("Needs attention")}</h2>
                <span class="text-body-sm text-muted">
                  {summary.needsAttention.length}
                </span>
              </>
            </div>
            {summary.needsAttention.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState title={t("Nothing needs attention right now.")} />
            ) : (
              <div class="panel divide-y divide-border">
                {attentionCases
                  .filter(
                    (c) => c.status === "MISSING_DATA" || c.status === "OVERDUE"
                  )
                  .map((c) => {
                    // missingData is a JSONB column with no schema
                    // enforcement: cases whose readiness was last computed by
                    // an older app version can still carry a legacy
                    // plain-string shape instead of today's {meterType,
                    // label, reason} object (see the same fix in
                    // periods/[periodId]/index.astro).
                    const missing = c.missingData as (
                      | {
                          label: string | null;
                          meterType: string;
                          reason?: "NO_READING";
                        }
                      | {
                          billingRuleId: string;
                          ruleName: string;
                          reason?: "NO_MANUAL_INPUT";
                        }
                      | {
                          billingRuleId: string;
                          ruleName: string;
                          meterType: string;
                          reason: "NO_ACTIVE_METER_FOR_RULE";
                        }
                      | { reason: "NO_APPLICABLE_RULES" }
                      | string
                    )[];
                    const overdue = c.status === "OVERDUE";
                    const href = overdue
                      ? base + "/payments"
                      : base + "/periods/" + summary.period.id;
                    const readingsUrl = new URL(Astro.url);
                    readingsUrl.searchParams.set("drawer", "readings");
                    readingsUrl.searchParams.set("dwelling", c.dwellingId);
                    readingsUrl.searchParams.delete("focus");
                    return (
                      <div class="dashboard-attention-row">
                        <div class="dashboard-attention-content">
                          <div class="dashboard-attention-heading">
                            <a
                              class="dashboard-dwelling-link"
                              href={base + "/dwellings/" + c.dwellingId}
                            >
                              {t("Dwelling")} {c.dwellingNumber}
                            </a>
                            <StatusBadge status={c.status} />
                          </div>
                          <p class="text-body-sm text-muted">
                            {overdue
                              ? t(
                                  "Payment is past its due date. Review reconciliation."
                                )
                              : missing.length
                                ? missing
                                    .map((m) =>
                                      typeof m === "object" &&
                                      m &&
                                      m.reason === "NO_APPLICABLE_RULES"
                                        ? t("No billing rule applies")
                                        : typeof m === "object" &&
                                            m &&
                                            m.reason ===
                                              "NO_ACTIVE_METER_FOR_RULE"
                                          ? `${m.ruleName} — ${t("no active meter")}`
                                          : typeof m === "string"
                                            ? m
                                            : "billingRuleId" in m
                                              ? m.ruleName
                                              : (m.label ??
                                                entityLabel(
                                                  m.meterType,
                                                  locale
                                                ))
                                    )
                                    .join(", ")
                                : t(
                                    "All readings are present. Generate the invoice in the workbench."
                                  )}
                          </p>
                          {missing.length > 0 && (
                            <p class="mt-1 text-caption text-muted">
                              {t(
                                "Readings are required before generating an invoice."
                              )}
                            </p>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        {missing.length > 0 &&
                        !overdue &&
                        summary.period.status !== "LOCKED" ? (
                          <a
                            class="dashboard-attention-action"
                            href={readingsUrl.pathname + readingsUrl.search}
                            data-open-drawer="readings"
                            data-dwelling-id={c.dwellingId}
                            aria-haspopup="dialog"
                            aria-controls="admin-context-drawer"
                          >
                            {t("Add readings")}
                            <Icon name="arrow-right" size="xs" />
                          </a>
                        ) : (
                          <a class="dashboard-attention-action" href={href}>
                            {t(overdue ? "Review payments" : "Open workbench")}
                            <Icon name="arrow-right" size="xs" />
                          </a>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
              </div>
            )}
          </section>
          <div class="space-y-6">
            <>
              <section class="dashboard-case-status panel p-5">
                <>
                  <h2 class="section-title">{t("Case status")}</h2>
                  <div class="space-y-1">
                    {statuses.map((status) => (
                      <a
                        class="dashboard-status-link text-body-sm"
                        href={
                          base +
                          "/periods/" +
                          summary.period.id +
                          "?status=" +
                          status
                        }
                      >
                        <StatusBadge status={status} />
                        <span class="dashboard-status-count font-semibold tabular-nums">
                          {summary.caseStatusCounts[status]}
                          <Icon name="arrow-right" size="xs" />
                        </span>
                      </a>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </>
              </section>
              <section class="panel p-5">
                <>
                  <h2 class="section-title flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Icon name="droplet" size="sm" class="text-muted" />
                    {t("Consumption")}
                  </h2>
                  <dl class="space-y-3 text-body-sm">
                    <>
                      <div class="flex justify-between gap-3">
                        <>
                          <dt class="text-muted">{t("Cold water")}</dt>
                          <dd class="font-semibold tabular-nums">
                            {formatNumber(summary.coldWaterConsumption, locale)}{" "}
                            m³
                          </dd>
                        </>
                      </div>
                      <div class="flex justify-between gap-3">
                        <>
                          <dt class="text-muted">{t("Hot water")}</dt>
                          <dd class="font-semibold tabular-nums">
                            {formatNumber(summary.hotWaterConsumption, locale)}{" "}
                            m³
                          </dd>
                        </>
                      </div>
                    </>
                  </dl>
                </>
              </section>
            </>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }
</AdminLayout>

export type CaseStatusCounts = Record<
  (typeof billingCaseStatusEnum.enumValues)[number],
  number
>;

export interface AttentionItem {
  caseId: string;
  dwellingId: string;
  dwellingNumber: string;
  status: (typeof billingCaseStatusEnum.enumValues)[number];
  // billing_cases.missing_data JSONB (legacy rows may hold plain strings).
  missingData: unknown[];
  // OVERDUE rows only (null otherwise): what this dwelling still owes on the
  // period invoice, the invoice due date, and whole days past it.
  overdueAmount: string | null;
  dueDate: string | null;
  daysLate: number | null;
}

export type NextActionKey =
  | "ENTER_READINGS"
  | "GENERATE_INVOICES"
  | "SEND_INVOICES"
  | "REVIEW_PAYMENTS"
  | "CREATE_NEXT_PERIOD"
  | "ALL_DONE";

export interface DashboardSummary {
  period: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getPeriod>>;
  // True when this is the organization's newest billing month.
  isNewestPeriod: boolean;
  // totalInvoiced is this month's CHARGES only (= currentCharges). Paid and
  // outstanding are measured against amountDue (charges + carried debt -
  // credits + late fees), so headline amountDue and show the breakdown.
  totalInvoiced: string;
  currentCharges: string;
  carriedOutstanding: string;
  creditsApplied: string;
  lateFees: string;
  amountDue: string;
  totalPaid: string;
  totalOutstanding: string;
  coldWaterConsumption: string;
  hotWaterConsumption: string;
  // Readings the system carried forward after the deadline (zero consumption).
  carriedForwardReadingCount: number;
  caseStatusCounts: CaseStatusCounts;
  needsAttention: AttentionItem[];
  progress: {
    dwellingsTotal: number;
    // Cases past MISSING_DATA.
    readingsDone: number;
    // Cases with an invoice: DRAFT, PREPARED, SENT, OVERDUE, PAID.
    invoicesGenerated: number;
    // Cases whose invoice went out: SENT, OVERDUE, PAID.
    invoicesSent: number;
    invoicesPaid: number;
  };
  nextAction: { key: NextActionKey; count: number };
  deadlines: {
    readingDeadline: string | null;
    invoiceIssueDate: string;
    invoiceDueDate: string;
  };
  // Org-wide: bank transactions with no match yet / matches awaiting review.
  unmatchedPaymentCount: number;
  proposedPaymentCount: number;
  // This period's invoices not sent whose last delivery FAILED or is UNKNOWN.
  deliveryFailureCount: number;
  readiness: { billingReady: boolean; readyToSend: boolean };
}

// First applicable step of the month, in workflow order.
function pickNextAction(
  counts: CaseStatusCounts,
  locked: boolean,
  isNewest: boolean
): DashboardSummary["nextAction"] {
  if (locked)
    return { key: isNewest ? "CREATE_NEXT_PERIOD" : "ALL_DONE", count: 0 };
  const steps: [NextActionKey, number][] = [
    ["ENTER_READINGS", counts.MISSING_DATA],
    ["GENERATE_INVOICES", counts.READY],
    ["SEND_INVOICES", counts.DRAFT + counts.PREPARED],
    ["REVIEW_PAYMENTS", counts.SENT + counts.OVERDUE],
  ];
  const [key, count] = steps.find(([, n]) => n > 0) ?? ["ALL_DONE", 0];
  return { key, count };
}

// "Work requiring attention" (spec Section 27): a dwelling with no reading
// yet (MISSING_DATA) or a sent invoice already past its due date (OVERDUE)
// -- both need an admin to do something, unlike DRAFT/PREPARED which are
// just normal steps in the monthly workflow still in progress.
const ATTENTION_STATUSES = new Set(["MISSING_DATA", "OVERDUE"]);

export async function getDashboardSummary(
  db: Db,
  organizationId: string,
  periodId: string
): Promise<DashboardSummary> {
  const period = await getPeriod(db, organizationId, periodId);
  const [org] = await db
    .select({ currency: organizations.currency })
    .from(organizations)
    .where(eq(organizations.id, organizationId))
    .limit(1);

  const allPeriodInvoices = await db
    .select({
      id: invoices.id,
      currentCharges: invoices.currentCharges,
      previousOutstanding: invoices.previousOutstanding,
      previousCreditApplied: invoices.previousCreditApplied,
      lateFeeApplied: invoices.lateFeeApplied,
      amountDue: invoices.amountDue,
      paidAt: invoices.paidAt,
      sentAt: invoices.sentAt,
      dueDate: invoices.dueDate,
      billingCaseId: invoices.billingCaseId,
      currency: invoices.currency,
    })
    .from(invoices)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(invoices.organizationId, organizationId),
        eq(invoices.periodId, periodId)
      )
    );
  // An invoice's currency is snapshotted from the organization's setting at
  // generation time (spec Section 21) and never changes afterward, but the
  // organization's own currency setting can change later (ORG-002). Summing
  // every invoice regardless would silently add incompatible currencies
  // together under whatever label the org happens to have today -- only
  // invoices still matching today's currency are counted.
  const periodInvoices = allPeriodInvoices.filter(
    (i) => i.currency === org.currency
  );
  const invoiceIds = periodInvoices.map((i) => i.id);
  const allocations = invoiceIds.length
    ? await db
        .select({
          invoiceId: paymentAllocations.invoiceId,
          amount: paymentAllocations.allocatedAmount,
        })
        .from(paymentAllocations)
        .where(
          and(
            eq(paymentAllocations.organizationId, organizationId),
            inArray(paymentAllocations.invoiceId, invoiceIds)
          )
        )
    : [];
  const reversals = invoiceIds.length
    ? await db
        .select({
          invoiceId: paymentReversals.invoiceId,
          amount: paymentReversals.reversedAllocationAmount,
        })
        .from(paymentReversals)
        .where(
          and(
            eq(paymentReversals.organizationId, organizationId),
            inArray(paymentReversals.invoiceId, invoiceIds)
          )
        )
    : [];
  const allocatedByInvoice = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const allocation of allocations) {
    allocatedByInvoice.set(
      allocation.invoiceId,
      sumExact([
        allocatedByInvoice.get(allocation.invoiceId) ?? "0.00",
        allocation.amount,
      ])
    );
  }
  for (const reversal of reversals) {
    allocatedByInvoice.set(
      reversal.invoiceId,
      maxExact(
        subtractExact(
          allocatedByInvoice.get(reversal.invoiceId) ?? "0.00",
          reversal.amount
        ),
        "0.00"
      )
    );
  }
  const currentCharges = sumExact(periodInvoices.map((i) => i.currentCharges));
  const carriedOutstanding = sumExact(
    periodInvoices.map((i) => i.previousOutstanding)
  );
  const creditsApplied = sumExact(
    periodInvoices.map((i) => i.previousCreditApplied)
  );
  const lateFees = sumExact(periodInvoices.map((i) => i.lateFeeApplied));
  const amountDue = sumExact(periodInvoices.map((i) => i.amountDue));
  const totalPaid = sumExact(
    periodInvoices.map((invoice) => {
      const allocated = allocatedByInvoice.get(invoice.id) ?? "0.00";
      return invoice.paidAt && allocated === "0.00"
        ? invoice.amountDue
        : allocated;
    })
  );
  const outstandingByInvoice = new Map(
    periodInvoices.map((invoice) => [
      invoice.id,
      maxExact(
        subtractExact(
          invoice.amountDue,
          invoice.paidAt && !allocatedByInvoice.has(invoice.id)
            ? invoice.amountDue
            : (allocatedByInvoice.get(invoice.id) ?? "0.00")
        ),
        "0.00"
      ),
    ])
  );
  const totalOutstanding = sumExact([...outstandingByInvoice.values()]);
  const totalInvoiced = currentCharges;

  const readings = await db
    .select({
      type: meters.type,
      unit: meters.unit,
      source: meterReadings.source,
      consumption: meterReadings.consumption,
    })
    .from(meterReadings)
    .innerJoin(meters, eq(meters.id, meterReadings.meterId))
    .where(
      and(
        eq(meterReadings.organizationId, organizationId),
        eq(meterReadings.periodId, periodId)
      )
    );
  // meters.unit is free text, not an enum -- summing consumption across
  // meters with different units (e.g. m3 and litres) would silently add
  // incompatible quantities. This dashboard KPI only ever labels the result
  // "m3" (the unit this app's water meters are always configured with), so
  // only readings actually in that unit are counted.
  const WATER_UNIT = "m3";
  const coldWaterConsumption = sumExact(
    readings
      .filter((r) => r.type === "COLD_WATER" && r.unit === WATER_UNIT)
      .map((r) => r.consumption)
  );
  const hotWaterConsumption = sumExact(
    readings
      .filter((r) => r.type === "HOT_WATER" && r.unit === WATER_UNIT)
      .map((r) => r.consumption)
  );

  const carriedForwardReadingCount = readings.filter(
    (r) => r.source === "CARRIED_FORWARD"
  ).length;

  const cases = await db
    .select({
      id: billingCases.id,
      dwellingId: billingCases.dwellingId,
      dwellingNumber: dwellings.number,
      status: billingCases.status,
      missingData: billingCases.missingData,
    })
    .from(billingCases)
    .innerJoin(dwellings, eq(dwellings.id, billingCases.dwellingId))
    .where(
      and(
        eq(billingCases.organizationId, organizationId),
        eq(billingCases.periodId, periodId)
      )
    );
  const caseStatusCounts = Object.fromEntries(
    billingCaseStatusEnum.enumValues.map((status) => [status, 0])
  ) as CaseStatusCounts;
  const invoiceByCase = new Map(periodInvoices.map((i) => [i.billingCaseId, i]));
  const needsAttention: AttentionItem[] = [];
  for (const c of cases) {
    caseStatusCounts[c.status]++;
    if (ATTENTION_STATUSES.has(c.status)) {
      const overdue = c.status === "OVERDUE" ? invoiceByCase.get(c.id) : null;
      needsAttention.push({
        caseId: c.id,
        dwellingId: c.dwellingId,
        dwellingNumber: c.dwellingNumber,
        status: c.status,
        missingData: Array.isArray(c.missingData) ? c.missingData : [],
        overdueAmount: overdue ? outstandingByInvoice.get(overdue.id)! : null,
        dueDate: overdue?.dueDate ?? null,
        daysLate: overdue
          ? Math.max(
              0,
              Math.floor((Date.now() - Date.parse(overdue.dueDate)) / 86_400_000)
            )
          : null,
      });
    }
  }
  const n = caseStatusCounts;
  const invoicesSent = n.SENT + n.OVERDUE + n.PAID;

  // Newest real billing month (the starting-readings month is never one).
  const [newest] = await db
    .select({ id: billingPeriods.id })
    .from(billingPeriods)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(billingPeriods.organizationId, organizationId),
        eq(billingPeriods.openingReadings, false)
      )
    )
    .orderBy(desc(billingPeriods.year), desc(billingPeriods.month))
    .limit(1);
  const isNewestPeriod = newest?.id === periodId;

  // Unsent invoices whose last delivery attempt did not succeed.
  const unsentIds = periodInvoices.filter((i) => !i.sentAt).map((i) => i.id);
  const failedDeliveries = unsentIds.length
    ? await db
        .selectDistinct({ invoiceId: invoiceDeliveries.invoiceId })
        .from(invoiceDeliveries)
        .where(
          and(
            eq(invoiceDeliveries.organizationId, organizationId),
            inArray(invoiceDeliveries.invoiceId, unsentIds),
            inArray(invoiceDeliveries.status, ["FAILED", "UNKNOWN"])
          )
        )
    : [];

  return {
    period,
    isNewestPeriod,
    totalInvoiced,
    currentCharges,
    carriedOutstanding,
    creditsApplied,
    lateFees,
    amountDue,
    totalPaid,
    totalOutstanding,
    coldWaterConsumption,
    hotWaterConsumption,
    carriedForwardReadingCount,
    caseStatusCounts,
    needsAttention,
    progress: {
      dwellingsTotal: cases.length,
      readingsDone: cases.length - n.MISSING_DATA,
      invoicesGenerated: n.DRAFT + n.PREPARED + invoicesSent,
      invoicesSent,
      invoicesPaid: n.PAID,
    },
    nextAction: pickNextAction(n, period.status === "LOCKED", isNewestPeriod),
    deadlines: {
      readingDeadline: period.readingDeadline,
      invoiceIssueDate: period.invoiceIssueDate,
      invoiceDueDate: period.invoiceDueDate,
    },
    // ponytail: both lists load full rows just to count them; add COUNT
    // queries if an org ever has thousands of open bank transactions.
    unmatchedPaymentCount: (await listUnmatchedTransactions(db, organizationId))
      .length,
    proposedPaymentCount: (
      await listPaymentMatches(db, organizationId, "PROPOSED")
    ).length,
    deliveryFailureCount: failedDeliveries.length,
    readiness: {
      billingReady: cases.length > 0 && n.MISSING_DATA === 0,
      readyToSend: n.DRAFT + n.PREPARED > 0,
    },
  };
}

    color: var(--color-foreground);

  /* Set on every element, not on body: an em value inherits as a fixed length
     (16px x 0.03 = 0.48px), so each element has to resolve 0.03em against its
     own font size. Form controls are listed because preflight sets
     letter-spacing: inherit on them with a higher specificity than `*`.
     This rule is in the base layer on purpose: any tracking-* utility and any
     explicit letter-spacing elsewhere (eyebrows, big numerals) still wins. */
  *,

  input,
  select,

    letter-spacing: var(--tracking-sans);

  /* General rule (all pages): the native <select> arrow is a UA widget
     that ignores the element's own padding and sits flush at the border
     edge. Replaced with a CSS chevron inset to the same 0.75rem the text
     itself uses, so it reads as part of the field's content instead of
     floating outside it. Dark-mode stroke color swap lives unlayered,
     near the other prefers-color-scheme overrides, since unlayered CSS
     always beats this layered default regardless of selector specificity.
     Kept as its own rule, separate from the shared button/summary/select

    background-repeat: no-repeat;

     to (not buttons/links, which keep the plain outline above). */
  input:not([type="hidden"]):not([type="checkbox"]):not(
      [type="radio"]
    ):focus-visible,
  select:focus-visible,
  textarea:focus-visible {
    outline: none;
    border-color: var(--color-primary);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-focus-ring);
  }
  input[type="checkbox"],
  input[type="radio"] {
    width: 1rem;
    height: 1rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  label {
    line-height: 1.5;
  }
  table {
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  th {
    font-weight: 600;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  td {
    vertical-align: middle;
  }
}

/* Section 15/16: icon geometry -- 1.75px stroke, round caps/joins, applied

/* Section 17: exact reduced-motion reset from the spec, kept alongside
   the more surgical per-feature guards elsewhere in this file (theme
   flip, drawer/dialog entrance, button/row hover) as a blanket backstop
   for any transition/animation added later without its own guard. */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *,
  *::before,
  *::after {
    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
  }
}

/* Theme-switch transition: lib/ui/theme.ts's setTheme() stamps this
   attribute for ~180ms around the data-theme flip. Scoping the transition
   to that window (rather than a permanent rule on every element) means the
   theme change animates smoothly without also slowing down ordinary
   hover/focus/disabled state changes elsewhere. */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  :root[data-theme-transition],
  :root[data-theme-transition] :where(*, *::before, *::after) {
    transition-property:
      background-color, color, border-color, outline-color, box-shadow, fill,
      stroke;
    transition-duration: 180ms;
    transition-timing-function: ease;
  }
}

   regardless of which admin page renders it. Originally scoped to
   AdminContextDrawer.astro's own <style is:global> block, but Astro only
   bundles a component's styles onto pages that actually render that
   component -- pages without their own AdminContextDrawer instance (guide,
   settings, dwellings list, payments, ...) never received this CSS, so
   AdminLayout's shared #mobile-nav-drawer (which reuses these same
   classes) rendered unstyled on those pages. Moved here so every admin
   page gets it via AdminLayout's global.css import. */

/* Slide-in/out + backdrop fade. @starting-style + allow-discrete is the
   standard way to animate a native <dialog>'s entrance AND its exit
   (dialog.close() normally removes [open] and unrenders it instantly) --
   no JS timing hooks needed for the animation itself. Entirely inside the
   reduced-motion guard: outside it, the dialog has no transition
   properties at all and just snaps open/closed as before. */

      translate: 100% 0;

/* Section 17: exact reduced-motion reset from the spec, kept alongside

   flip, drawer/dialog entrance, button/row hover) as a blanket backstop

/* Theme-switch transition: lib/ui/theme.ts's setTheme() stamps this
   attribute for ~180ms around the data-theme flip. Scoping the transition
   to that window (rather than a permanent rule on every element) means the
   theme change animates smoothly without also slowing down ordinary
   hover/focus/disabled state changes elsewhere. */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  :root[data-theme-transition],
  :root[data-theme-transition] :where(*, *::before, *::after) {
    transition-property:
      background-color, color, border-color, outline-color, box-shadow, fill,
      stroke;
    transition-duration: 180ms;
    transition-timing-function: ease;
  }
}

/* Generic contextual-drawer shell, unlayered so it always applies
   regardless of which admin page renders it. Originally scoped to
   AdminContextDrawer.astro's own <style is:global> block, but Astro only
   bundles a component's styles onto pages that actually render that
   component -- pages without their own AdminContextDrawer instance (guide,
   settings, dwellings list, payments, ...) never received this CSS, so
   AdminLayout's shared #mobile-nav-drawer (which reuses these same
   classes) rendered unstyled on those pages. Moved here so every admin
   page gets it via AdminLayout's global.css import. */
.context-drawer {
  position: fixed;
  inset-block: 0;
  inset-inline-end: 0;
  inset-inline-start: auto;
  width: min(480px, 100vw);
  max-width: 100vw;
  height: 100%;
  max-height: 100%;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  border-inline-start: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  background: var(--color-surface);
  color: var(--color-foreground);
  /* Directional variant of --elevation-overlay (Section 6.2) -- same
     ink-based shadow color/intensity, offset toward the page instead of
     downward since this panel is anchored to the right edge. */
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-drawer);
}
.context-drawer::backdrop {
  background: var(--color-backdrop);
}
.context-drawer[open] {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
/* Slide-in/out + backdrop fade. @starting-style + allow-discrete is the
   standard way to animate a native <dialog>'s entrance AND its exit
   (dialog.close() normally removes [open] and unrenders it instantly) --
   no JS timing hooks needed for the animation itself. Entirely inside the
   reduced-motion guard: outside it, the dialog has no transition
   properties at all and just snaps open/closed as before. */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .context-drawer {
    translate: 100% 0;
    opacity: 0;
    transition:
      translate 220ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1),
      opacity 180ms ease,
      overlay 220ms allow-discrete,
      display 220ms allow-discrete;
  }
  .context-drawer[open] {
    translate: 0 0;
    opacity: 1;
  }
  @starting-style {
    .context-drawer[open] {
      translate: 100% 0;
      opacity: 0;
    }
  }
  .context-drawer::backdrop {
    background: transparent;
    transition:
      background-color 180ms ease,
      overlay 220ms allow-discrete,
      display 220ms allow-discrete;
  }
  .context-drawer[open]::backdrop {
    background: var(--color-backdrop);
  }
  @starting-style {
    .context-drawer[open]::backdrop {
      background: transparent;
    }
  }
}

/* Phones: `.stack-table` wrappers render each row as a labelled card
   (labels come from stack-tables.ts). Unlayered + !important on the
   structural bits so page-scoped table styles (min-width, borders) lose. */

    overflow-wrap: anywhere;

    font-weight: 600;
    text-align: left;
  }

    display: none !important;
  }
}

import type { IconName } from "./icons";

// Strict status -> icon mapping (Tabler Icons, Outline). Never invent a new
// icon per state -- the icon reinforces the text label, it never replaces
// it, so states that share a meaning share an icon.
const statuses: Record<string, [string, string, IconName]> = {
  MISSING_DATA: ["Missing data", "danger", "alert-triangle"],
  READY: ["Ready to invoice", "warning", "check"],
  DRAFT: ["Draft", "neutral", "file-description"],
  PREPARED: ["Prepared", "info", "check"],
  SENT: ["Sent", "info", "send"],
  PAID: ["Paid", "success", "circle-check"],
  OVERDUE: ["Overdue", "warning", "clock-exclamation"],
  // "OPEN" is shared by two unrelated domains (billing period + message
  // thread) -- "lock-open" reads sensibly for both ("not yet locked" /
  // "not yet resolved") without inventing a per-domain variant.
  OPEN: ["Open", "info", "lock-open"],
  LOCKED: ["Locked", "neutral", "lock"],
  ACTIVE: ["Active", "success", "check"],
  ARCHIVED: ["Archived", "neutral", "archive"],
  NEW: ["Awaiting reply", "warning", "clock-exclamation"],
  RESOLVED: ["Resolved", "success", "circle-check"],
  PROPOSED: ["Proposed", "info", "clock"],
  CONFIRMED: ["Confirmed", "success", "check"],
  REJECTED: ["Rejected", "neutral", "x"],
  REVERSED: ["Reversed", "neutral", "x"],
  UNMATCHED: ["Unmatched", "warning", "alert-triangle"],
  FAILED: ["Failed", "danger", "alert-triangle"],
};

export function invoiceStatusBadge(status: string) {
  const [label, tone, icon] = statuses[status] ?? [
    status,
    "neutral",
    "info-circle",
  ];
  return { label, tone, icon, className: "status-badge" };
}

export function translate(locale: Locale, text: string): string {
  if (locale === "lv") return lv[text] ?? text;
  if (locale === "ru") return ru[text] ?? text;
  return text;
}

// "{done} of {total}" -> "3 of 5". Values are shown as given.
export function fill(
  text: string,
  values: Record<string, string | number>
): string {
  return text.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (m, k) =>
    k in values ? String(values[k]) : m
  );
}

// Count-dependent sentence. English picks `one` for 1, else `other`. Latvian
// and Russian look up `${other}|${category}` (CLDR via Intl.PluralRules; Latvian
// "zero" uses the "|other" entry), so "21 dienu" / "11 dienām" come out right.
export function plural(
  locale: Locale,
  n: number,
  one: string,
  other: string
): string {
  let text = n === 1 ? one : other;
  if (locale !== "en") {
    const category = new Intl.PluralRules(locale).select(n);
    const forms = [`${other}|${category}`, `${other}|other`];
    text = translate(locale, forms[0]);
    if (text === forms[0]) text = translate(locale, forms[1]);
    if (text === forms[1]) text = translate(locale, other);
  }
  return fill(text, { n: formatNumber(n, locale) });
}

// Shared by every page rendering an Astro Action's error: never shows raw
// Zod/ActionInputError JSON. When the action failed Zod input validation
// (`error.fields` present), shows the first field's plain-language message,
// translated -- every such message in this codebase is itself an English
// sentence used as the i18n dictionary key (see e.g. src/actions/billing.ts's
// UNIT_PRICE_MESSAGE), so this always resolves to a real, localized string.
// A path-less Zod issue (rare, but possible from an object-level .refine())
// leaves `.fields` present but with no usable message -- that falls back to
// a generic translated message, never to `.message` (which for an input
// error IS the raw "Failed to validate: [...]" blob). Only a genuine
// non-input error (domain ConflictError/NotFoundError/etc., already a safe
// human sentence -- see src/actions/_errors.ts) uses its own `.message`.
export function friendlyActionErrorMessage(
  error:
    { message: string; fields?: Record<string, string[]> } | null | undefined,
  locale: Locale
): string | undefined {
  if (!error) return undefined;
  if (error.fields) {
    const fieldMessage = Object.values(error.fields)[0]?.[0];
    return translate(
      locale,
      fieldMessage ?? "Something went wrong. Please try again."
    );
  }
  return translate(locale, error.message);
}

// Stored decimals ("15.0000") shown without trailing zeros, but never fewer
// than `min` places and never rounding away real precision (up to 6).
export function formatTrimmed(
  value: string | number,
  locale: Locale,
  min = 2
): string {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, {
    minimumFractionDigits: min,
    maximumFractionDigits: 6,
  }).format(Number(value));
}

export function formatNumber(
  value: string | number,
  locale: Locale,
  maximumFractionDigits = 3
): string {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { maximumFractionDigits }).format(
    Number(value)
  );
}

export function formatMoney(
  value: string,
  currency: string,
  locale: Locale
): string {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { style: "currency", currency }).format(
    Number(value)
  );
}

export function formatDate(
  value: string | Date | null,
  locale: Locale,
  timeZone = "UTC"
): string {
  if (!value) return "—";
  const dateOnly =
    typeof value === "string" && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value);
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, {
    dateStyle: "medium",
    timeZone: dateOnly ? "UTC" : timeZone,
  }).format(new Date(value));
}

export function formatDateTime(
  value: string | Date | null,
  locale: Locale,
  timeZone = "UTC"
): string {
  if (!value) return "—";
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, {
    dateStyle: "medium",
    timeStyle: "short",
    timeZone,
  }).format(new Date(value));
}

export function formatPeriod(
  year: number,
  month: number,
  locale: Locale
): string {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, {
    month: "long",
    year: "numeric",
    timeZone: "UTC",
  }).format(new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, 1)));
}

  COLD_WATER: "Cold water",
  HOT_WATER: "Hot water",
  ELECTRICITY: "Electricity",
  GAS: "Gas",
  HEAT: "Heat",

  COMMERCIAL_UNIT: "Commercial unit",
  PARKING: "Parking",
  STORAGE: "Storage",
  ADMIN: "Administrator",
  RESIDENT: "Resident",
  IMPORT: "Import",
  CARRIED_FORWARD: "Previous reading reused",
};
export function entityLabel(value: string, locale: Locale): string {
  return translate(locale, names[value] ?? value);
}

+function missingReasons(items: unknown[]): string {
+  return (items as MissingItem[])
+    .map((item) => {
+      if (typeof item === "string") return item;
+      if (!item || typeof item !== "object") return "";

+      if (item.reason === "NO_ACTIVE_METER_FOR_RULE")

+      if ("billingRuleId" in item) return item.ruleName;
+      return item.label ?? entityLabel(item.meterType, locale);

+function missingReasons(items: unknown[]): string {

+    .join(", ");

+type AttentionRow =
+  | { kind: "case"; item: DashboardSummary["needsAttention"][number] }
+  | {
+      kind: "summary";
+      key: string;
+      label: string;
+      href: string;
+      tone: "info" | "warning" | "danger";
+      icon: IconName;
+    };
+
+const attentionRows: AttentionRow[] = summary
+  ? summary.needsAttention.map((item) => ({ kind: "case" as const, item }))
+  : [];
+if (summary?.unmatchedPaymentCount) {
+  attentionRows.push({
+    kind: "summary",
+    key: "unmatched",
+    label: plural(
+      locale,
+      summary.unmatchedPaymentCount,
+      "{n} bank payment is not matched to an invoice yet.",
+      "{n} bank payments are not matched to an invoice yet."
+    ),
+    href: `${base}/payments?view=UNMATCHED`,
+    tone: "warning",
+    icon: "alert-triangle",
+  });
+}
+if (summary?.proposedPaymentCount) {
+  attentionRows.push({
+    kind: "summary",
+    key: "proposed",
+    label: plural(
+      locale,
+      summary.proposedPaymentCount,
+      "{n} suggested payment match is waiting for your check.",
+      "{n} suggested payment matches are waiting for your check."
+    ),
+    href: `${base}/payments?view=PROPOSED`,
+    tone: "info",
+    icon: "clock",
+  });
+}
+if (summary?.deliveryFailureCount) {
+  attentionRows.push({
+    kind: "summary",
+    key: "delivery",
+    label: plural(
+      locale,
+      summary.deliveryFailureCount,
+      "{n} invoice could not be delivered.",
+      "{n} invoices could not be delivered."
+    ),
+    href: `${workbenchPath}?status=PREPARED`,
+    tone: "danger",
+    icon: "alert-triangle",
+  });
+}
+if (summary?.caseStatusCounts.READY) {
+  attentionRows.push({
+    kind: "summary",
+    key: "ready",
+    label: plural(
+      locale,
+      summary.caseStatusCounts.READY,
+      "{n} invoice can be created.",
+      "{n} invoices can be created."
+    ),
+    href: `${workbenchPath}?status=READY`,
+    tone: "info",
+    icon: "receipt-euro",
+  });
+}
+const readyToSendCount = summary
+  ? summary.caseStatusCounts.DRAFT + summary.caseStatusCounts.PREPARED
+  : 0;
+if (readyToSendCount) {
+  attentionRows.push({
+    kind: "summary",
+    key: "send",
+    label: plural(
+      locale,
+      readyToSendCount,
+      "{n} invoice is ready to send.",
+      "{n} invoices are ready to send."
+    ),
+    href: `${workbenchPath}?status=DRAFT`,
+    tone: "info",
+    icon: "send",
+  });
+}
+if (summary?.caseStatusCounts.SENT) {
+  attentionRows.push({
+    kind: "summary",
+    key: "waiting",
+    label: plural(
+      locale,
+      summary.caseStatusCounts.SENT,
+      "{n} invoice is waiting for payment.",
+      "{n} invoices are waiting for payment."
+    ),
+    href: `${base}/payments`,
+    tone: "info",
+    icon: "clock",
+  });
+}
+
+const visibleAttentionRows = attentionRows.slice(0, 5);
+const attentionItemCount = summary
+  ? summary.needsAttention.length +
+    summary.unmatchedPaymentCount +
+    summary.proposedPaymentCount +
+    summary.deliveryFailureCount +
+    summary.caseStatusCounts.READY +
+    readyToSendCount +
+    summary.caseStatusCounts.SENT
+  : 0;
+const attentionAllHref = summary?.caseStatusCounts.MISSING_DATA
+  ? `${workbenchPath}?status=MISSING_DATA`
+  : summary?.caseStatusCounts.OVERDUE
+    ? `${workbenchPath}?status=OVERDUE`
+    : summary?.caseStatusCounts.READY
+      ? `${workbenchPath}?status=READY`
+      : readyToSendCount
+        ? `${workbenchPath}?status=DRAFT`
+        : `${base}/payments`;
+
+function readingsHref(
+  item: DashboardSummary["needsAttention"][number]
+): string {
+  const url = new URL(Astro.url);
+  url.searchParams.set("drawer", "readings");
+  url.searchParams.set("dwelling", item.dwellingId);
+  url.searchParams.delete("focus");
+  return url.pathname + url.search;

codex
One existing unit test intentionally preserves ungrouped four-digit Latvian amounts for the general formatter, while this dashboard explicitly requires grouped ledger columns. I’m keeping the shared default compatible and adding the narrowest opt-in to `formatMoney`, used only by this dashboard’s money figures.

+type MissingItem =
+  | { label: string | null; meterType: string; reason?: "NO_READING" }
+  | { billingRuleId: string; ruleName: string; reason?: "NO_MANUAL_INPUT" }
+  | {
+      billingRuleId: string;
+      ruleName: string;
+      meterType: string;
+      reason: "NO_ACTIVE_METER_FOR_RULE";
+    }
+  | { reason: "NO_APPLICABLE_RULES" }
+  | string;
+
+function missingReasons(items: unknown[]): string {
+  return (items as MissingItem[])
+    .map((item) => {
+      if (typeof item === "string") return item;
+      if (!item || typeof item !== "object") return "";
+      if (item.reason === "NO_APPLICABLE_RULES")
+        return t("No billing rule applies");
+      if (item.reason === "NO_ACTIVE_METER_FOR_RULE")
+        return `${item.ruleName} — ${t("no active meter")}`;
+      if ("billingRuleId" in item) return item.ruleName;
+      return item.label ?? entityLabel(item.meterType, locale);
+    })
+    .filter(Boolean)
+    .join(", ");

# graphify reference: incremental update and cluster-only

Load this only when the user passed `--update` or `--cluster-only`. A first-time full build never reads this file.

## For --update (incremental re-extraction)

Use when you've added or modified files since the last run. Only re-extracts changed files - saves tokens and time.

```bash
$(cat graphify-out/.graphify_python) -c "
import sys, json
from graphify.detect import detect_incremental, save_manifest
from pathlib import Path

result = detect_incremental(Path('INPUT_PATH'))
new_total = result.get('new_total', 0)
print(json.dumps(result, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
Path('graphify-out/.graphify_incremental.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False), encoding=\"utf-8\")
deleted = list(result.get('deleted_files', []))
if new_total == 0 and not deleted:
    print('No files changed since last run. Nothing to update.')
    raise SystemExit(0)
if deleted:
    print(f'{len(deleted)} deleted file(s) to prune.')
if new_total > 0:
    print(f'{new_total} new/changed file(s) to re-extract.')
"
```

Then populate `.graphify_detect.json` so Steps 3A–6 (which read it unconditionally) see the right state for an incremental run. `files` carries the changed subset (drives Step 3A AST + Step 3B0 cache check on only what changed); `all_files` carries the full corpus for any step that needs corpus-wide context:

```bash
$(cat graphify-out/.graphify_python) -c "
import json
from pathlib import Path
r = json.loads(Path('graphify-out/.graphify_incremental.json').read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))
Path('graphify-out/.graphify_detect.json').write_text(json.dumps({
    'files': r.get('new_files', {}),
    'all_files': r.get('files', {}),
    'total_files': r.get('new_total', 0),
    'total_words': r.get('total_words', 0),
    'skipped_sensitive': r.get('skipped_sensitive', []),
    'needs_graph': True,
}, ensure_ascii=False), encoding=\"utf-8\")
"
```

If new files exist, first check whether all changed files are code files:

```bash
$(cat graphify-out/.graphify_python) -c "
import json
from pathlib import Path

result = json.loads(open('graphify-out/.graphify_incremental.json', encoding='utf-8').read()) if Path('graphify-out/.graphify_incremental.json').exists() else {}
code_exts = {'.py','.ts','.js','.go','.rs','.java','.cpp','.c','.rb','.swift','.kt','.cs','.scala','.php','.cc','.cxx','.hpp','.h','.kts','.lua','.toc','.f','.F','.f90','.F90','.f95','.F95','.f03','.F03','.f08','.F08'}
new_files = result.get('new_files', {})
all_changed = [f for files in new_files.values() for f in files]
code_only = all(Path(f).suffix.lower() in code_exts for f in all_changed)
print('code_only:', code_only)
"
```

If `code_only` is True: print `[graphify update] Code-only changes detected - skipping semantic extraction (no LLM needed)`, run only Step 3A (AST) on the changed files, skip Step 3B entirely (no subagents), then go straight to merge and Steps 4–8.

If `code_only` is False (any changed file is a doc/paper/image/video): **first, if any changed file is in `new_files['video']`, run `references/transcribe.md` (Step 2.5) on those files, then rewrite `.graphify_detect.json` to move the resulting transcript paths into `files['document']` and drop `files['video']`** — otherwise raw `.mp4/.mp3` paths are fed to semantic subagents as unreadable media (#1392). Then run the full Steps 3A–3C pipeline as normal.


If no new files exist (only deletions), create an empty extraction so the merge step can prune:

```bash
if [ ! -f graphify-out/.graphify_extract.json ]; then
    echo '[graphify update] Only deletions -- creating empty extraction for merge.'
    $(cat graphify-out/.graphify_python) -c "
import json
from pathlib import Path
Path('graphify-out/.graphify_extract.json').write_text(json.dumps({'nodes':[],'edges':[],'hyperedges':[],'input_tokens':0,'output_tokens':0}), encoding='utf-8')
"
fi
```


Then:

```bash
$(cat graphify-out/.graphify_python) -c "
import json
from pathlib import Path
from graphify.build import build_merge
from graphify.detect import save_manifest

# Load new extraction and incremental state
new_extraction = json.loads(Path('graphify-out/.graphify_extract.json').read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))
incremental = json.loads(Path('graphify-out/.graphify_incremental.json').read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))
deleted = list(incremental.get('deleted_files', []))
# prune_sources is ONLY for genuinely DELETED files. Changed/re-extracted files are
# handled by build_merge's replace-on-re-extract (#1344): every source_file in
# new_chunks is dropped from the base before merge, so old/stale nodes don't survive.
# Do NOT add `changed` here: with root= passed, prune_set relativizes to the same base
# as the freshly merged nodes and would DELETE the re-extracted content (#1178 is moot
# now that replace — not the dedup pass — reconciles changed files).
prune = list(deleted) or None

# Use build_merge() — reads graph.json directly without NetworkX round-trip
# so edge direction (calls, implements, imports) is always preserved (#801).
# Pass root= so prune_sources (absolute paths from detect_incremental) are
# relativized to match the graph's relative source_file values; without it
# nothing is pruned and stale nodes accumulate on every update (#1361).
# directed=IS_DIRECTED: replace IS_DIRECTED with True if --directed was given, else
# False. Without it a --directed --update silently rebuilds undirected and collapses
# reciprocal A<->B edges (#1392).
G = build_merge(
    [new_extraction],
    graph_path='graphify-out/graph.json',
    prune_sources=prune,
    root='INPUT_PATH',
    directed=IS_DIRECTED,
)
print(f'[graphify update] Merged: {G.number_of_nodes()} nodes, {G.number_of_edges()} edges')

# Write merged result back to .graphify_extract.json so Step 4 sees the full graph
merged_out = {
    'nodes': [{'id': n, **d} for n, d in G.nodes(data=True)],
    'edges': [
        # Explicit source/target last so they win over any stale attrs in d.
        {**{k: val for k, val in d.items() if k not in ('_src', '_tgt', 'source', 'target')},
         'source': d.get('_src', u), 'target': d.get('_tgt', v)}
        for u, v, d in G.edges(data=True)
    ],
    # G.graph["hyperedges"] holds hyperedges from both existing graph.json
    # and new_extraction (build_merge combines them). Falling back to
    # new_extraction only would silently drop prior-run hyperedges (#801).
    'hyperedges': list(G.graph.get('hyperedges', [])),
    'input_tokens': new_extraction.get('input_tokens', 0),
    'output_tokens': new_extraction.get('output_tokens', 0),
}
Path('graphify-out/.graphify_extract.json').write_text(json.dumps(merged_out, ensure_ascii=False), encoding=\"utf-8\")
print(f'[graphify update] Merged extraction written ({len(merged_out[\"nodes\"])} nodes, {len(merged_out[\"edges\"])} edges)')

# Save manifest so next --update diffs against today's state, not the
# prior run's baseline (prevents ghost-node reports on subsequent updates).
# root= matches the build_merge call above so the manifest keys stay relative to
# the scan root — portable across clones/machines, so --update keeps matching
# cached files instead of missing every one after a move (#1417).
#
# Only stamp semantic files (docs/papers/images) that ACTUALLY produced output
# THIS run (new_extraction is this run's fresh extraction, read above before the
# merge overwrote the file): a changed doc whose chunk failed must stay unstamped
# so the next --update re-queues it, otherwise it is marked done and its content
# is lost forever (#2015). Mirrors the library extract path
# (cli._stamped_manifest_files + clear_semantic + scan_corpus).
from graphify.cli import _stamped_manifest_files
_manifest_files = _stamped_manifest_files(incremental['files'], new_extraction, Path('INPUT_PATH'))
# Changed semantic files dispatched this run but NOT stamped had their chunk fail
# or be omitted; clear any stale semantic_hash so they are re-queued (#1948).
_sem_types = ('document', 'paper', 'image')
_dispatched = {f for t, fl in incremental.get('new_files', {}).items() if t in _sem_types for f in fl}
_stamped = {f for fl in _manifest_files.values() for f in fl}
_cleared = _dispatched - _stamped
# scan_corpus = the RAW full corpus so in-root files newly excluded since last run
# are dropped rather than masquerading as deletions; untouched rows preserved (#1908).
_scan = {f for fl in incremental['files'].values() for f in fl}
save_manifest(_manifest_files, root='INPUT_PATH', scan_corpus=_scan, clear_semantic=_cleared or None)
print('[graphify update] Manifest saved.')
"
```

Then run Steps 4–8 on the merged graph as normal.

After Step 4, show the graph diff:

```bash
$(cat graphify-out/.graphify_python) -c "
import json
from graphify.analyze import graph_diff
from graphify.build import build_from_json
from networkx.readwrite import json_graph
import networkx as nx
from pathlib import Path

# Load old graph (before update) from backup written before merge
old_data = json.loads(Path('graphify-out/.graphify_old.json').read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")) if Path('graphify-out/.graphify_old.json').exists() else None
new_extract = json.loads(Path('graphify-out/.graphify_extract.json').read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))
G_new = build_from_json(new_extract, directed=IS_DIRECTED)

if old_data:
    G_old = json_graph.node_link_graph(old_data, edges='links')
    diff = graph_diff(G_old, G_new)
    print(diff['summary'])
    if diff['new_nodes']:
        print('New nodes:', ', '.join(n['label'] for n in diff['new_nodes'][:5]))
    if diff['new_edges']:
        print('New edges:', len(diff['new_edges']))
"
```

Before the merge step, save the old graph: `cp graphify-out/graph.json graphify-out/.graphify_old.json`
Clean up after: `rm -f graphify-out/.graphify_old.json`

## For --cluster-only

Skip Steps 1–3. Re-run clustering on the existing graph:

```bash
graphify cluster-only .
```

`graphify cluster-only .` is **self-contained**: it re-clusters, names communities, and regenerates `GRAPH_REPORT.md`, `graph.json`, and `graph.html` from the existing graph. **Do not re-run Steps 5–9** — they read intermediate files (`.graphify_extract.json`, `.graphify_detect.json`, `.graphify_analysis.json`) that a prior build's cleanup (Step 9) already deleted, so they raise `FileNotFoundError` (#1392). When it finishes, present the refreshed `GRAPH_REPORT.md` summary as usual.
